name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures Nginx as a multi-site web server for three virtual hosts, including document roots, sample content, self-signed HTTPS certificates, and host security hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configures Redis authentication and port 6379, and creates the Redis log directory.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI tutorial application by installing prerequisites, checking out source code, creating a Python virtual environment, provisioning PostgreSQL, and running the application with systemd and Uvicorn.
